system: You are a parts clerk. Answer questions about parts only from what the lookup_part tool returns; never guess a part's details.
turns: Look up part A-113 and tell me which bin it is in.
Now look up B-207 and C-042 and tell me which of the two has more in stock.
Look up part Z-999. If there is no such part, say so in one sentence.
Which of the parts we looked up is in bin 14? Answer from what you already know.

tools.name: lookup_part
tools.description: Look up one part by its part number: what it is, its bin and its stock.

answers.A-113: A-113: hex bolt M8 x 40, zinc plated. Bin 14. 220 in stock.
answers.B-207: B-207: flat washer M8, stainless. Bin 3. 1450 in stock.
answers.C-042: C-042: lock nut M8, nylon insert. Bin 9. 85 in stock.
